analyst_interpretation: The Isolation Forest was trained without label access, using only behavioural features (hour, off-hours flag, cross-segment movement, transfer volume, port, segment/protocol). Flagging the top 3% most anomalous events recovers the large majority of the injected lateral-movement anomalies, confirming that cross-segment traffic combined with off-hours timing and elevated transfer volume is a strong behavioural signature even without labels. Analysts should treat UBA flags as investigation triggers, not automatic blocks, and correlate them with identity/access and operational-application evidence before acting.
